user_saw: When the Codex receiver’s execution budget expired during startup, the terminal error said only `turn/start aborted`.
summary: The fix preserves the originating abort reason as `Error.cause` and includes its text in the Codex app-server cancellation message.
reasoning: The client already reduced signal cancellations to a generic abort message before its typed cancellation wrapper was introduced. I checked that #134755 moved execution-budget enforcement from watches armed after turn startup to a deadline that could call `runAbortController.abort(error)` while `turn/start` was pending. That new use of the existing signal exposed the loss of its reason.
